function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a polynomial function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x_value.description: The x-value at which the derivative is calculated. Optional, if not given, the function will return a function of the derivative instead of a specific value. default is 0.

The user wants to calculate derivative of polynomial 3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7. Then evaluate at x=4. Then calculate derivative of resulting function (i.e., derivative of derivative?) and evaluate at x=2. So basically compute first derivative f'(x) = 9x^2 - 4x + 5. Evaluate at x=4: f'(4) = 9*16 - 4*4 + 5 = 144 - 16 + 5 = 133. Then derivative of resulting function: derivative of f'(x) is f''(x) = 18x - 4. Evaluate at x=2: f''(2) = 36 - 4 = 32. So answer: derivative is 9x^2 - 4x + 5, f'(4)=133, second derivative is 18x - 4, f''(2)=32.
